description: ABS international trade in goods and services is a group of 2 related entries of the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue, listed under the National Freight Data Hub group and published by ABS; Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS). Members: ABS data for International Merchandise Trade; International Trade in Goods and Services, Australia. Example entry: The Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) International Merchandise Trade data is valuable for understanding import and export commodities passing through Australia’s ports and airports. It contains detailed records of commodity information by tonnes and value, port of departure, port of arrival, country of origin and destination, and mode of transport. Coverage is Australia, 1997 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as monthly, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2026-09-15. Files and pages listed: HTML, ZIP (6 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU; other members not stated. Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies and network flow and freight or traffic assignment models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
